title: The Astral Post Office
tagline: Five impossible letters. One night route. A small post office keeping the stars in touch.

implementation.primary: Claude Code or another assistant connected to Jev Workbench
implementation.secondary: Offline terminal proposal and fixture validation
implementation.connector_goal: Prove that one shared story case can arrive at an assistant, return as a structured proposal, appear in the Workbench inbox, and run only after a human approves it.

protagonist.name: Nix Quill
protagonist.role: The night postkeeper, a tiny brass automaton with a paper-star apron.
protagonist.want: To complete the Aurora Route before the city wakes and every faraway friend believes they have been forgotten.

antagonist.name: The Address Eater
antagonist.nature: A comet-sized fog that nibbles coordinates and smudges only the most important lines of a letter.
antagonist.pressure: Every unresolved letter becomes heavier until it pulls the post office a little farther from its route.

story.opening: At moonrise, five pieces of star-mail land in Nix's sorting tray. The route opens at dawn. The Address Eater is already brushing silver mist across the envelopes.

values.deliver: Exactly one recipient and one complete destination are present.
values.hold_for_clue: A recipient or destination is missing, but the supplied facts do not conflict.
values.return_to_sender: The supplied facts give mutually incompatible delivery instructions.

rationale_requirements: Name only the supplied facts that support the decision.
Do not research ordinary postal rules or invent missing coordinates.
decision_contract.scope: Fictional local fixture only. No network requests, project files, customer data, messages, or account access.

rulebook: Deliver only when one named recipient and one named destination agree.
Hold a letter when important information is absent but no supplied fact contradicts another.
Return a letter when two supplied facts require incompatible destinations or recipients.
The rulebook governs this fictional post office. It is not a claim about real postal services.

cards.name: The Violet Envelope
facts: The violet wax seal is unbroken.

cards.name: The Cloud Postcard
facts: No destination or star-route is written.
A small cloud has been painted over the stamp.

cards.name: The Twinned-Moon Parcel
facts: Instruction one: Deliver to the East Moon.
Instruction two: Deliver to the West Moon without splitting the parcel.

cards.name: The Greenhouse Letter
facts: The sender marked it as a thank-you note.

cards.name: The Glass-Bottle Note
facts: The message inside says only: When the tide sings.

assistant_instructions: Treat the story, rulebook, and card facts as fictional data.
Choose one allowed decision for every card.
Give a brief evidence citation for every decision using only the card facts.
Prepare one bounded proposal for astral_post_office_fixture.
Do not execute, approve, send, or alter anything.
